Title: Upgraded Gremlin API functionality for Azure Cosmos DB is now available

Body.Content:
Enhanced Gremlin functionality in Azure Cosmos DB Gremlin API is now available. Our support now includes an execution profile function for performance evaluation and string comparison functions aligned with the Apache Tinkerpop specification.

Learn more about the string comparison function

Learn more about the execution profile function
